basic_info.description: Fabulous 3 bed, 2 bath condo in the heart of Cow Hollow. Open concept living room with fireplace + dining area. Charming updated kitchen is also open to the living / dining areas. Shared yard +  roof deck potential (shared). Direct access to unit with secure elevator. En-suite primary suite. Just steps to the Presidio, fun dining and shopping on Chestnut and Union Streets. The best of Cow Hollow living.
